The '''Duel on Corulag''' was a duel between former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jook-jook H'broozin]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Danzigorro Potts]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. After H'broozin's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] and his joining of the [[Legions of Lettow]], he was hunted down continuously by his former Padawan Danzigorro Potts until Potts had cornered him on Corulag where he ran him through, ended the life of his former Master.
